description: Hand-written in the documented response format (no live capture possible in the build environment); field names are exactly the ones the adapters read. Bodies are raw response text, expectations are the parsed Ticker (-1 = Ticker.NO_DATA, change24hPercent null = must not be set). Shared by ExchangeContractTest.kt (Android) and ExchangeContractTests.swift (iOS).

cases.name: market summary Xbt/Aud: CreatedTimestampUtc is the summary time, not a trade time (exchange time unknown); vol = DayVolumeXbtInSecondaryCurrrency (coins traded on this pair; DayVolumeXbt sums all counter currencies)
cases.note: Recorded 2026-10-16 (Xbt/Aud): DayVolumeXbt 21.53, DayVolumeXbtInSecondaryCurrrency 19.786 — both in coins despite the name; the triple r is the real field name.
